Associate Salesforce Developer & QA Engineer

The CCS Companies is hiring an Associate Salesforce Developer & QA Engineer to support the quality and reliability of Salesforce solutions used in core business processes. The role initially focuses on regression testing, test automation, defect tracking, and user acceptance testing, with a path toward Salesforce development through mentorship and training.
Finance
Information Technology
Telecom & Communications
Financial Services
Messaging
Responsibilities
Executes and maintains regression test suites for Salesforce releases, enhancements, and integrations
Builds out and expand test automation frameworks and scripts
Identifies, documents, and tracks defects, working to implement and verify fixes
Supports the team's development lifecycle by testing, deploying, and documenting changes
Partners with developers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria
Supports business users during UAT by preparing test scripts and documenting results
Creates and manages test data in sandbox environments, following data-masking and PII handling standards
Runs regression testing for Salesforce’s three annual platform releases and internal releases
Learns Salesforce development (Apex, LWC, SOQL) through mentorship, code reviews, and hands-on starter tasks, taking on more development work over time
Ability to maintain a consistent and regular attendance in accordance with an established schedule
Ability to work onsite/in-office and in accordance with CCS and department policies and procedures

Required
1-3 years of experience in software development, QA, or a related field (internships, projects, and bootcamps count)
Working knowledge of Java, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Familiarity with software testing concepts, including regression, functional, and defect tracking
Basic understanding of APIs and version control (e.g., Git)
Basic knowledge of SQL to support data validation
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and clear written communication
Eagerness to learn Salesforce; no prior Salesforce experience required
Preferred
Exposure to test automation tools or frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, JUnit) is a plus
Salesforce Trailhead progress or certifications (e.g., Administrator) are a plus
Experience with CI/CD tools or telephony applications (Five9, Genesys, Talkdesk, RingCentral) is a plus
B.S. Degree preferred or directly related equivalent experience
Benefits
Mentorship and training to grow into Salesforce development
